record.dic_text:
04732 Miqlowth {mik-lohth'} (或可能是mik-kel-ohth')

04731 的陰性複數; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Mikloth 4; 4

米基羅 = "棍棒"
1) 便雅憫人, 耶利的眾子之一, 耶利是基遍的父親或基遍城的建立者, 耶利的妻子是瑪迦
2) 大衛軍隊第二班的首領 (#代上 27:4|)
record.edic_text:
04732 Miqlowth {mik-lohth'} (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth')

plural of (feminine) 04731;; n pr m

AV - Mikloth 4; 4

Mikloth = "staves"
1) one of the sons of Jehiel, the father or prince of Gibeon by his
        wife Maachah; a Benjamite
2) leader of the 2nd division of David's army
